item.title: Augusta suspect picks fireplace as hiding spot during SWAT standoff
item.description: A 35-year-old man was taken into custody Friday evening after barricading himself inside a home and later hiding in a fireplace while deputies attempted to serve outstanding warrants. item.title: Daylight Saving Time begins Sunday morning
item.description: Daylight saving time begins early Sunday morning for most Americans, meaning many will need to move their clocks forward one hour. The post Daylight Saving Time begins Sunday morning appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Bill would require candidates to raise at least half their money within Georgia
item.description: Republicans in the Georgia Senate passed a bill Friday that bans candidates from raising more than half of their campaign money from outside of the state, a limitation that Democrats said inhibits their fundraising in nationalized elections. The post Bill would require candidates to raise at least half their money within Georgia appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Salvation Army partners with Tacocat for March donation drive
item.description: The Salvation Army of Augusta is partnering with Tacocat in downtown Augusta to host a March Spring Cleaning donation drive benefiting the Center of Hope shelter. The post Salvation Army partners with Tacocat for March donation drive appeared first on The Augusta Press.
